turns.text: Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
Mrs. Kalinowski is fine, but I didn't come to talk about my schedule. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Reasonable isn't the same as satisfied. Answer the question: who decided on the zero?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not on the same side. You haven't answered me. Who decided on the zero, and what do you have besides the checker?
